inspection_target_exclusive.name: inspection_target_exclusive
inspection_target_exclusive.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN "inspections"."structure_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "inspections"."infrastructure_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "inspections"."equipment_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      ) = 1
